# Granyyte

> Granyyte is a software development agency in Sialkot, Pakistan, founded by Chand Latif (senior software engineer, certified FlutterFlow expert). We build mobile apps (Flutter and FlutterFlow, iOS and Android), SEO-first websites and web apps (Next.js), and custom business software for clients in Turkey, the UAE, Poland, the UK, the US and Pakistan. Projects are quoted as a fixed price against a written scope, and most ship in 2-4 weeks. Clients own the full source code.

## Services
- [Mobile app development](https://www.granyyte.com/services/mobile-app-development): Flutter and FlutterFlow apps for iOS and Android from one codebase
- [Web development](https://www.granyyte.com/services/web-development): fast, SEO-first websites and web applications
- [Custom software](https://www.granyyte.com/services/custom-software): CRMs, internal tools, inventory, school and attendance systems
- [Certified FlutterFlow developer in Pakistan](https://www.granyyte.com/flutterflow-developer-pakistan)
